'''April 2001 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New World Manga, Livingston, NJ on 28 April 2001. [[Patrick Ziagos]] won it. It is known from Michael Robinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01d2177/ new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01d2177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' New World Manga, Livingston, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrick Ziagos]]
